I've answered Hollis in a thread on their message in #central-random. The ticket is #88412.

Tobias raised it in #central-team on 2 Jul 2025 as a Tier 2 escalation: the gatehouse tablet at Door 6 kept freezing on the BOL barcode scan. Hollis is a member of #central-team, so this is information they can already see. In the same thread Tobias confirmed the ticket is for Tansleigh Packaging, not Tansley Parcel.

I also warned Hollis not to confuse it with #8841, a similar number for a different problem: West yard Door 2 double-booking on the dealer account.
